newsitem.title: CHINA: HK sees HK$377 bln fiscal reserves at end-Mar 1998.
newsitem.headline: HK sees HK$377 bln fiscal reserves at end-Mar 1998.

text.p: The Hong Kong government forecasts fiscal reserves of HK$377 billion as at March 31, 1998, Secretary for the Treasury K.C. Kwong said on Friday.

Kwong said the estimate included HK$174 billion in accumulated reserves as of March 31, 1997, the estimated balance of HK$170 billion from the Land Fund as of June 30, 1997, and the budget surplus of HK$38 billion for 1997/98 including investment earnings on the Land Fund, less a HK$5 billion transfer to the Mandatory Provident Fund Authority.
The estimate compares with a previous estimate fo HK$359 billion made in March 1997 when the 1997/98 budget was announced.
Since then, the government has said the 1996/97 budget surplus was HK$25.7 billion rather than the previous estimate of HK$15.1 billion.
